records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue increased by $38.8 million, or 15.8%, during the three months ended March 29, 2025 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This increase reflects higher spend by Network Equipment Manufacturers (NEMs), and aerospace and defense customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue increased by $45.4 million, or 6.1%, during the nine months ended March 29, 2025 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amortization of acquired technologies within Cost of revenues increased $2.6 million or 74.3% and $2.3 million or 22.1% during the three and nine months ended March 29, 2025, respectively, compared to the same periods a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended March 29, 2025, Cash provided by operating activities was $66.0 million, consisting of net income of $26.8 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g., depreciation, amortization, stock-based compensation and other non-cash items) totaling $54.0 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that used $14.8 million.
